issues.summary: Legacy enroll endpoint creates dual enrollment paths with divergent auth handling
issues.suggestion: Migrate remaining callers to the cohort-based enrollment endpoints, then delete src/pages/api/enroll.ts to eliminate the dual-path inconsistency.
evidence: enroll.ts is explicitly marked LEGACY in its docstring
enroll.ts creates a new Supabase client with hardcoded anon key rather than using a shared client
Two distinct enrollment code paths diverge on cohort association and error response shapes

issues.summary: Duplicated rate-limit.ts and rate-limiter.ts modules in src/lib
issues.suggestion: Determine which module is canonical, migrate all imports to it, and delete the duplicate.
evidence: Both src/lib/rate-limit.ts and src/lib/rate-limiter.ts exist as separate files
Two files with near-identical names in the same directory solving the same concern is a classic AI generation artifact

issues.summary: Enrollment API surface has grown by accretion — three overlapping endpoints
issues.suggestion: Consolidate enrollment endpoints under a single cohort-enrollment path. Remove or formally deprecate the legacy direct-enroll path.
evidence: enroll.ts (legacy), enroll-cohort.ts, and cohorts.ts all handle enrollment variants
Three overlapping paths create divergent logic and inconsistent API contracts for callers

issues.summary: Supabase client created per-request in legacy enroll.ts instead of using shared lib/supabase.ts
issues.suggestion: Use the shared Supabase client from lib/supabase.ts in all API routes for consistent initialization.
evidence: enroll.ts reads PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY directly inline
lib/supabase.ts exists as the shared client module but is not used by this endpoint

dimension_notes.naming_quality: Consistent, descriptive naming across components and lib. DiscussionThread, LessonDiscussionContainer, StrugglingStudents are domain-clear. Minor verbosity in some component names.
dimension_notes.logic_clarity: Most business logic is readable. Quiz grading, time-gating, and RLS policy tests are clear. Some API handlers mix auth, validation, and DB logic in single functions.
dimension_notes.type_safety: TypeScript used throughout. Some any types visible in test fixtures. Missing strict null checks in places.
dimension_notes.contract_coherence: lib/auth.ts and lib/security.ts are well-defined with clear contracts. Enrollment endpoints have diverged contracts due to legacy path.
dimension_notes.error_consistency: Fail-closed on JWT (returns null). API route error shapes vary between endpoints — some return {error:string}, others return {message:string}.
dimension_notes.abstraction_fitness: Good separation of auth, security, notifications, realtime into lib/ modules. Some components are doing too much (QuizCard handles state + logic + rendering).
dimension_notes.ai_generated_debt: rate-limit.ts / rate-limiter.ts duplication is a clear AI artifact. Test files have AAA comment scaffolding (// Arrange // Act // Assert) that reads as boilerplate-generated.
dimension_notes.high_level_elegance: Clear Astro + React hybrid architecture. Good separation of server-side pages and client-side components. The campus website purpose is coherent.
dimension_notes.mid_level_elegance: lib/ is well-organized but has 20 files — some could be merged. Components subdirectory structure (payments, search, certificates) is logical.
dimension_notes.low_level_elegance: Individual functions are generally clean. auth.ts JWKS pattern is elegant. Some handlers are long.
dimension_notes.cross_module_architecture: Auth flows through lib/auth.ts consistently for secure routes. Enrollment has dual paths that don't flow through the same module.
dimension_notes.initialization_coupling: Some API routes create Supabase clients directly rather than using the shared lib/supabase.ts. Inconsistent initialization.
dimension_notes.convention_outlier: Mostly consistent Astro + React conventions. Mix of .astro and .tsx for similar concerns is expected but sometimes arbitrary.
dimension_notes.dependency_health: 45 runtime deps is substantial for a campus website. jose, supabase, sanitize-html are all well-maintained. No obvious hallucinated packages.
dimension_notes.test_strategy: Unit tests cover business logic (quiz grading, progress, cohort analytics). Integration tests cover RLS, enrollment flows. E2E covers student/teacher journeys. Solid ~65-70% effective coverage of critical paths.
dimension_notes.api_surface_coherence: 41 API routes is large. Enrollment surface has grown by accretion. Several overlapping paths.
dimension_notes.authorization_consistency: JWKS-based JWT verification in auth.ts is strong. RLS enforced via Supabase. Some older endpoints use anon key patterns inconsistently.
dimension_notes.incomplete_migration: enroll.ts explicitly marked LEGACY but still active. This is a known incomplete migration.
dimension_notes.package_organization: src/ organized into components/, lib/, pages/, types/ — clear. Tests organized into unit/, integration/, e2e/, security/ — very clear.
dimension_notes.design_coherence: Campus website purpose is coherent. Slight scope expansion into admin, analytics, AI, payments suggests growth pressure on original design.
dimension_notes.advocacy_language_quality: Uses farmed animal, advocacy terminology consistently. No speciesist idioms detected.
dimension_notes.advocacy_security_posture: JWKS JWT verification, sanitize-html, rate limiting, RLS tests — security posture is solid for a campus website.
dimension_notes.advocacy_terminology_consistency: Tracks use animal_advocacy, climate, ai_safety. Terminology is consistent throughout.
dimension_notes.advocacy_data_sovereignty: Supabase RLS, no PII leakage patterns detected. Auth fail-closed.
dimension_notes.advocacy_ux_inclusivity: Playwright accessibility tests present. Multiple test personas. i18n unclear.
dimension_notes.advocacy_tool_integration: n8n workflow track, campus model for coding education in advocacy space — moderate integration with the broader OP tooling ecosystem.

dimension_judgment.incomplete_migration: LEGACY endpoint still serving traffic is not a minor issue — it creates dual enrollment paths with divergent error handling. Score reflects this.
dimension_judgment.ai_generated_debt: Two rate-limiting modules and AAA-scaffolded tests are clear AI generation artifacts. Not severe but real.
dimension_judgment.test_strategy: Good unit + integration + E2E coverage of critical paths. test_strategy score reflects actual breadth — not inflated.
